The App will work automatically. In order to individualize a training you first need to make an attempt with the maximum breath holding. The table CO2 is a series of static breath holdings with the decrease of the rest time at a constant breath holding time.
The table O2 is a series of static breath holdings with the increase of breath holding time at a constant rest time.
